notes: The Club Wired menu (original scene 8: create 0x1ba45, controls and draw 0x1bec1). Opening it deals the radio's playlist and plays a song (data/audio/radio.json); the scene's own music gives way to it, so the menu keeps what the radio plays.

The picture: the background (layer 1), the wheel's wedges and the translucent help panel (both layer 3; the port draws the panel over the wedges), the CURRENT MUSIC strip at y 296, the lit wedge of the item at rest and the item's name (layer 4).

wheel: the original draws eight slots, from the one before the wheel's item to six past it, each showing the item at that slot modulo six, turned about the pivot 45 degrees a slot; the item at rest sits at position with its wedge lit. A move turns the wheel over 8 frames, the short way round between the first and last items; it takes no input meanwhile. Positive angles turn clockwise. The original gives the pivot as (159.5, 80.5) from the wedge's centre (0x1b847; the drawer adds half the sprite size, 0xd3843), so from the top-left it is (231.5, 156.5).

The cursor moves sideways and wraps, with sys entry 23 ("wheel"). confirm plays 5, or 26 on Exit, and fades out to the item's screen over 0.5 s. cancel moves the cursor to Exit. Arriving from the town map plays 25.
The cursor starts on the item for the screen the menu opened from (start_items), otherwise on the first.
The help line scrolls through the panel's window (85, 211 to 265, 229), restarting on each move, each string padded by its own trail.

riding_plate: the RIDING SV plate with the ridden Scoobee's name slides in once the menu has faded in (0x6dd74 from 0x1bec1, see data/ui/frame.json); a new game rides none, so it shows only once a Scoobee is ridden.
